name: LM339
notes: Quad comparator. Outputs are open collector: each needs a pull-up resistor to give a high, typically 10k. It only sinks, about 16 mA. Output low (sinking) when IN- is above IN+, output off (pulled high) when IN+ is above IN-.
spice:
.subckt CHIP_LM339 out2 out1 vcc inm1 inp1 inm2 inp2 inm3 inp3 inm4 inp4 gnd out4 out3
Rin1 inp1 inm1 10Meg
Rin2 inp2 inm2 10Meg
Rin3 inp3 inm3 10Meg
Rin4 inp4 inm4 10Meg
Rs vcc gnd 5k
Bq1 out1 gnd I = v(out1,gnd)/30*lunes_step(v(inm1,gnd)-v(inp1,gnd),200)*lunes_step(v(vcc,gnd)-1.5,10)
Bq2 out2 gnd I = v(out2,gnd)/30*lunes_step(v(inm2,gnd)-v(inp2,gnd),200)*lunes_step(v(vcc,gnd)-1.5,10)
Bq3 out3 gnd I = v(out3,gnd)/30*lunes_step(v(inm3,gnd)-v(inp3,gnd),200)*lunes_step(v(vcc,gnd)-1.5,10)
Bq4 out4 gnd I = v(out4,gnd)/30*lunes_step(v(inm4,gnd)-v(inp4,gnd),200)*lunes_step(v(vcc,gnd)-1.5,10)
.ends CHIP_LM339
